question: Should `tool-progress` be a supported generic public Plugin SDK reply-payload contract?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but it creates permanent external API surface to connect a bundled producer with channel transports, which requires explicit ownership intent.

options.title: Approve public progress intent
options.body: Keep the constant and predicate as the canonical generic producer-to-channel contract and preserve it compatibly.

options.title: Keep the signal internal
options.body: Remove the public exports and carry the same typed fact through a narrow bundled-runtime seam.

recommendation.title: Approve public progress intent
recommendation.body: Keep the constant and predicate as the canonical generic producer-to-channel contract and preserve it compatibly.
